reviews.text: Really cool pet shop, love how much the staff knows about the animals. However, the star of the show is Debbbbbie , a super sweet, super patient employee. My child and I have been trying to figure out what pet to get (appropriate for her age and our lifestyle/schedule). We've been visiting for atleast 4 months...debating...we went from axolotl, to bird, to cat and with her EXTREME  patience we finally decided on a rabbit! I cant rave about Debbie enough,  she spent sooo much time explaining what we can expect, how best to care for a rabbit but mostly what really touched me is how much she wanted to make sure we got the right pet. Never felt rushed or pressured , always greeted with a huge smile and update on what animals are in and what she thought might interest us. All that to say, although it is not the closest pet shop to our home. I will ALWAYSSSSS, go there for pet food and any other pet supplies I may need JUST because of Debbie. To the owner of the shop, please give her a raise! She truly cares for the animals and is such a gem. And Debbie if you get a chance to read this, thank you a million for helping us, your kindness, patience and beautiful personality is truly appreciated ❤️

We had a very good experience at this pet shop, with a special mention for Annika who is truly wonderful. She gives excellent advice and we trust her completely with all our aquarium-related questions.

One small negative point: we bought a snail that unfortunately never showed any signs of life in our aquarium; it was already dead. These things can happen, but it's still disappointing.

Finally, it's a shame that we made many purchases at this shop before being informed about the loyalty card during our last visit. Given our spending, it would have been advantageous for us to know about it sooner.

Wrong information given about registering the microchip. And even after a week, it's still not transferred to my name. I called and they kept saying "Oh we are going to do it today" but they never did. I had to pay an extra fee to get that chip transferred to my name because they cannot fulfill their obligations, in addition to losing time.

I've been coming to Nature ever since I adopted my cat there, and I must say the team has always been lovely. Sonia, Anika, and the whole team are so warm and welcoming, and you can tell they love animals.

I own Loue1Robe, which is right next door, so I often stop by the store to get my cat's nails trimmed, buy treats, or ask for advice. It was always a pleasure to come.

However, I must say I'm very sad to no longer see Shannon, who was an exceptional person with animals. She was incredibly gentle with my cat and always took the time to give me great advice. She was truly a key part of the experience for me.

I know the current team is doing their best, and I wish them all the best, but Shannon leaves a big void for many loyal customers like myself.

I saw a woman touching a bird and pushing it away when it tried to nibble her fingers. That shouldn’t even be happening. Animals shouldn’t be handled by just anyone like that.

I also saw a bird alone in a tiny cage, pacing left and right in a loop. That’s a clear sign of stress.

The betta fish were kept in extremely small containers. The water looked dirty, there was no vegetation at all, and some of them had damaged fins.

There were also birds kept in rodent cages, with running wheels inside, and the cages were very small, even though there were 7 or 8 birds in one cage.

The workers didn’t say anything. They were too busy talking to each other, even while a woman was touching a bird right in front of them.

Amazing experience — truly caring and helpful team!

I can’t say enough good things about Nature (1500 Avenue Atwater, Niveau Mezzanine, Montréal).

This store sold me my favorite bird, and I absolutely love them. From day one, the staff were kind, patient, and genuinely helpful — they clearly care about the animals and about their customers.

What made me even happier is that yesterday they helped me find a mate for my bird, and it meant so much to me. They took the time to guide me, answer my questions, and make sure everything felt right. I left the store feeling excited, relieved, and honestly just so happy.

If you’re looking for a place where people actually listen, help you properly, and treat you with respect, I 100% recommend Nature. Thank you for everything! 🐦💛

If anyone is inclined to research where their exotic pets come from, I encourage you to look into the recent discovery of Nature Pet Store ferrets sourced from a breeding mill in Manitoba.

While tracing back breeding mills for exotic pets sold at local pet stores in Quebec (as well as all other provinces) can be quite difficult, these ferrets sold at Nature Pet Stores have been crammed in overcrowded cages where they cannot function even close to properly - as any animal should.

Nature Pet Stores may have great staff and nice store setups, but their consideration towards the welfare of their pets is alarming - and should be first and foremost.

Went there looking for plants. The store had a nice collection. I chose 10 plants for 55 plus a lotus for 10. The person was very nice and helped me choose. One of the plants I picked was not part of the promotion plants so the person who helped me asked his colleague and they agreed to include the plant as it was not marked and also pretty much dead (barely any roots).

Once I went to the cash, Sonia decided she won't let that pass and even though she didn't have a price for the plant, she decided the price is "15 at least". The plant was not in good condition. I told Sonia, if you don't honor the package done by your colleague, I won't take anything. She immediately took the plants away. She decided to forfeit an 80 dollar transaction to prove she's right. Sadly for the owner I ended up walking out not buying anything.

It's a shame because I met the owner before and I have no doubt she would've not been so picky. The plant was pretty much dead and there is no way it will survive now.

I also won't be coming there again because Sonia was not friendly, refused to honor a package done by her colleague and took the plants rudely off the cash and chose to cancel the transaction.

The worse part is I know most of the plants will die in a week and won't be sold.

Sometimes an employee will let their emotions spread to the customer and forget it's a business where you should be accommodating to keep your customers coming back.

In this case one frustrated employee costs the store 80 dollar transaction and any other future possible transactions.

I wish you all the best but this was my last visit.
